items.quote: She set the direction for steadying a team facing adversity across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Torsa Dovake spearheaded stakeholder consultations for the licensing review at the national level.
Direct reports said that Torsa Dovake championed public communications on the new scheme and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Several respondents noted that Torsa Dovake managed coaching and mentoring junior officers for her unit.
Several respondents noted that Torsa Dovake led the overnight response when the haze situation escalated across the department.
Several respondents noted that Torsa Dovake delivered her share of bilateral negotiations on the water agreement reliably.
Peers observed that Torsa Dovake drove cost savings across procurement for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Torsa took ownership of analytics to guide resource allocation and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Torsa Dovake set the direction for the partnership with sister agencies on youth services across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Torsa championed the rethink of subsidy rules for elderly households and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Several respondents noted that Torsa championed the five-year strategic plan for the division and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Direct reports said that Torsa took ownership of upholding governance and audit standards and steered it to completion.
She delivered her share of root cause analysis of recurring service failures reliably.
She took ownership of the transformation of the operating model and steered it to completion.
